title: 第21章 老熟人第22章 珍宝阁大师兄
lines: 司仪显然没有遇见过这种情况，顿时一愣，随后马上赔笑，宣布女方出场。
走台的后方，秦小鱼在父亲的搀扶下，慢慢走了出来，而在秦小鱼刚出来时我就发现了不对劲！
秦小鱼身上出现了“气”
而且这道“气”
甚至还有些熟悉！
秦小鱼面无表情的往前走着，而秦小鱼的父亲却满脸笑容，只是这种场合，我并没有发现秦方秦老爷子，按道理说应该到场的!
秦小鱼一身洁白的短纱礼服，衬托着她更加的温文尔雅，还带着一丝干练。
而就在秦小鱼走到台上，那叫木云轩的男子准备从秦小鱼父亲手中接过秦小鱼的手时，我猛地站起了身，冲着台上的木云轩喊道。
“你是什么人！
为什么强迫小鱼！”
我的声音很大，甚至盖过了场所播放的音乐，台下所有人的目光也全部都汇聚在我的身上。
秦小鱼父亲听到声音后，一看是我。
“白枫，你胡闹什么！
还有谁放你进来的！
保安！
保安！
秦小鱼的父亲喊道。
而秦小鱼听到我的声音后，慢慢转过头，脸上的表情很是挣扎，但是却没有说话，眼神也微微空洞。
保安在听到声音后，赶忙走了过来，而周黎抄起板凳就要打，被我一把拦住，然后灵气一震，几名保安直接倒地。
而木云轩在看到我出手后，眼中闪过一丝惊讶，随即再次恢复那高高在上的态度。
“有些意思，不过你以为修行点皮毛，就能纵横天下了？”
木云轩开口说道，语气尽是轻蔑。
我嘴角勾起一抹冷笑，我最讨厌跟我装B的人，当初上学时，那么多人围殴我，而我总里逮着一个最能装B的朝死里打。
“你用卑鄙的手段逼迫小鱼与你订婚，也不是什么好人！”
我冷冷的说道。
而木云轩听完后，却轻蔑一笑，转头就看着一旁的秦小鱼，然后说道。
“小鱼，你愿意嫁给我吗？”
声音带着胜利者的骄傲，看着台下的我，而台上的秦小鱼满脸挣扎，而最后却点了点头！
看到秦小鱼点头以后，秦小鱼的父亲冲着我喊道。
“白枫！
你看到了没！
没有人强迫小鱼！
而且你算个什么东西，敢在这里大呼小叫！
在这里闹事！”
我没有搭理秦小鱼父亲的咆哮，而是死死的盯着那个叫木云轩的男人。
“你这是逼我对你出手的！”
看到我那想要杀人的眼神，木云轩却毫不在意。
“你没那个能力，也没有那个资格！”
他话音刚落，我就如同鬼魅一般的冲向了木云轩，木云轩看到突然消失在原地的我，顿时神色一愣，旋即就恢复正常。
冲着木云轩全力一击的右拳被挡了下了来！
强大的气震得我不由的退了几步，而气血一阵翻涌，这是我第一次跟修行者交手。
content_en:
The emcee had obviously never encountered such a situation before. He was stunned for a moment, then immediately smiled and announced the woman's appearance.
Behind the catwalk, Qin Xiaoyu slowly walked out with the support of his father, and when Qin Xiaoyu just came out, I noticed something was wrong!
"Qi" appeared on Qin Xiaoyu's body
And this "qi"
It’s even a bit familiar!
Qin Xiaoyu walked forward expressionlessly, but Qin Xiaoyu's father was smiling. It's just that on this occasion, I didn't find Mr. Qin Fang. Mr. Qin logically should be there!
Qin Xiaoyu was wearing a pure white short gauze dress, which made her even more gentle and elegant, with a hint of sophistication.
And just when Qin Xiaoyu walked to the stage and the man named Mu Yunxuan was about to take Qin Xiaoyu's hand from his father, I stood up suddenly and shouted to Mu Yunxuan on the stage.
"Who are you!
Why force the little fish! "
My voice was so loud that it even drowned out the music playing in the venue, and all the eyes of everyone in the audience were focused on me.
When Qin Xiaoyu's father heard the sound, he saw it was me.
"Bai Feng, what are you talking about?
Who else let you in?
Security!
Security!
Qin Xiaoyu's father shouted.
After Qin Xiaoyu heard my voice, he slowly turned his head. The expression on his face was very struggling, but he didn't speak, and his eyes were slightly empty.
After hearing the sound, the security guard hurriedly came over. Zhou Li picked up the bench and was about to hit him, but I stopped him. Then, with a shock of spiritual energy, several security guards fell to the ground.
After Mu Yunxuan saw my move, a trace of surprise flashed in his eyes, and then he resumed his condescending attitude.
"It's interesting, but do you think you can conquer the world by practicing a little bit? "
Mu Yunxuan said, his tone full of contempt.
A sneer appeared at the corner of my mouth. I hated people who pretended to be fake with me. When I was in school, so many people surrounded me and beat me, but I always caught the one who was the best at pretending and beat him to death.
“You used despicable means to force Xiaoyu to get engaged to you, you are not a good person either! "
I said coldly.
After Mu Yunxuan heard this, he smiled contemptuously, turned to look at Qin Xiaoyu beside him, and said.
"Xiaoyu, will you marry me? "
His voice was filled with the pride of a winner, looking at me in the audience, while Qin Xiaoyu on the stage was struggling, but in the end he nodded!
After seeing Qin Xiaoyu nod, Qin Xiaoyu's father shouted to me.
"Bai Feng!
Did you see it?
No one forces Xiaoyu!
And who do you think you are, daring to make such a fuss here!
Making trouble here! "
I ignored Qin Xiaoyu's father's roar, but stared at the man named Mu Yunxuan.
“You forced me to take action against you! "
Seeing my murderous look, Mu Yunxuan didn't care at all.
"You don't have the ability or the qualifications! "
As soon as he finished speaking, I rushed towards Mu Yunxuan like a ghost. When Mu Yunxuan saw me suddenly disappearing from the place, his expression was stunned, and he soon returned to normal.
“Bang! "
The right fist that was aimed at Mu Yunxuan was blocked!
The powerful energy shocked me and I couldn't help but take a few steps back, while my energy and blood surged. This was my first time fighting against a practitioner.
